data.description:
## Goal
Add a `description` field to `BotTuningFieldSpec` and `BotTuningToggleSpec`, populate every entry with designer-facing text drawn from the existing JSDoc in `tunables.ts`, `botHumanLike.ts`, and `worldModel.ts`, and add a test asserting every declared field/toggle has a non-empty description.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `BotTuningFieldSpec` and `BotTuningToggleSpec` each have a `description: string` field.
2. All 48 numeric field specs and all 3 toggle specs have a non-empty `description`.
3. Descriptions faithfully reflect the parameter's documented behaviour from the source JSDoc — no invented behaviour.
4. A unit test in `src/ai/tuningFields.test.ts` asserts every entry in `BOT_TUNING_NUMERIC_FIELDS` and `BOT_TUNING_TOGGLES` has a non-empty `description` string.

## Key Files:
- `src/ai/tuningFields.ts` — add `description` to interfaces and every entry
- `src/ai/framework/competent/tunables.ts` — source of descriptions (JSDoc)
- `src/ai/botHumanLike.ts` — source of descriptions (JSDoc)
- `src/ai/framework/worldModel.ts` — source of descriptions (JSDoc)
- `src/ai/tuningFields.test.ts` — add coverage assertion test
